label: FEMA Open Shelters → TAK
info:
Open shelters in Tennessee from the FEMA National Shelter System (Red Cross and partners). Closed shelters are left off.

Data: FEMA National Shelter System (https://gis.fema.gov/). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/fema-open-shelters
